profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft Azure
profile.summary:
I'm a backend and distributed systems engineer at Microsoft Azure, where I build cloud infrastructure for authorization and large-scale data processing.

My work spans distributed ingestion, message-driven processing, partitioning, storage and indexing, REST APIs, reliability, disaster recovery, observability, and safe production rollout. I enjoy systems where correctness, scalability, availability, and operational safety matter.

Core areas: Distributed Systems, Backend Engineering, Microsoft Azure, Cloud Infrastructure, Event-Driven Architecture, Data Pipelines, REST APIs, Authorization / RBAC, Reliability Engineering, High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Observability, C#, Python, Java, SQL, and KQL.
Native proficiency in both English and Korean.
